instruments.name: Finger Bass
instruments.description: A round electric bass played with the fingers, a little growl over a solid fundamental, for band and pop parts.

instruments.name: Clean Guitar
instruments.description: A clean single-coil electric guitar with a pick click and a mellowing tail, for arpeggios, funk chords, and surf lines.

instruments.name: Crunch Guitar
instruments.description: A crunchy overdriven rhythm guitar through an amp and cabinet, for power chords and riffs played as roots and fifths.

instruments.name: Palm-Mute Chug
instruments.description: The muted, percussive low chug of a distorted rhythm guitar, for metal and pop-punk riffs.

instruments.name: Saw Pluck
instruments.description: The classic short, bright filtered-saw pluck that snaps shut at once, for arpeggios and pop basslines.

instruments.name: Nylon Guitar
instruments.description: A soft, warm, round classical guitar with a gentle fingertip pluck, for acoustic parts and quiet accompaniment.

instruments.name: Jazz Guitar
instruments.description: The dark, round neck-pickup tone of a hollow-body guitar, for busy comping and mellow jazz lines.

instruments.name: Xylophone
instruments.description: Short, dry, woody bar hits with a crisp mallet tick, for chase music and skeleton jokes.

instruments.name: Flute
instruments.description: An airy, round flute with a breath of noise and a gentle swell in its level, for riffs and woodwind melodies.

instruments.name: Pop Rock Kit
instruments.description: An 80s band kit for pop and rock songs: kick, snare, six toms, hats that choke each other, two crashes, ride, tambourine, and a plain cabasa for steady sixteenths, on the General MIDI drum notes.
